Rav'i: [광역 피해] Spend all Renewing Mist charges before Ssscavenging; when it starts, keep Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) up and put Rising Sun Kick and Spinning Crane Kick into the shield
[해제] Detox the Regurgitate disease; if several people are hit, clear them all at once with Revival
[탱버] Put Enveloping Mist on the tank before the 3-hit Hydrastrike; if their health is low, use Life Cocoon
The Writhing Coil: [해제] Detox the Spiteful Venom poison stacking on the Spiteful Hunt target
[광역 피해] During the 35 sec Synchronized Venom DoT, roll Renewing Mist around the party and spread Invigorating Mists healing with Vivify
[광역 피해] During Uncoil, Spinning Crane Kick on the 5 gathered Uncoiled Writhes also heals allies via Way of the Crane
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] Alternate Invoke Chi-Ji and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) on each Ritual of the Fang channel, and cover it with Thunder Focus Tea and Sheilun's Gift if both are on cooldown
[참고] Put Enveloping Mist on players who cleared Ritual Venom by standing in the Boneslicer line (7 sec Physical dot) or brushing a slowed Axegrinder axe, so they survive the Physical damage

[탱버] The two Chop Down hits (484912 Physical each) clear the tank's Ritual Venom stacks, so put Enveloping Mist on the tank before the cast and reapply a Thunder Focus Tea empowered Enveloping Mist right after the second hit

Lightblossom Trinity: [광역 피해] Pre-place Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist before the 8 sec Lightbloom Overgrowth, then cast Vivify for Invigorating Mists healing when it goes off

[탱버] Bedrock Slam (484912 Physical + 193965 Nature) comes soon after the Lightblossom Beam soak ends, so keep Renewing Mist on players standing in Fertile Loam to block the beam, and put a Thunder Focus Tea empowered Enveloping Mist on the tank as the soak ends
[참고] Hit the stacked three bosses with Rising Sun Kick, Tiger Palm, then Blackout Kick to keep Jadefire Teachings healing going
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Detox allies rooted by Bloodthorn Roots (magic); if Detox is on cooldown, free them with Tiger's Lust
[광역 피해] Use Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) for Thorncaller Roar, and save Revival for the Lightcrazed Frenzy phase after 50%
[회피] If you're the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, gain distance with Roll
Lightwarden Ruia: [광역 피해] Stack Revival and Invoke Chi-Ji into Spirits of the Vale after 40%

[탱버] Warden's Wrath, which the tank takes repeatedly in Moonkin Form, is Nature (magic) damage, and in Bear Form Mangling Claws doubles melee damage, so keep Enveloping Mist on the tank through both forms and use Life Cocoon if it gets dangerous
[참고] A player still bleeding from Grievous Thrash who gets the Pulverizing Strikes mark is in danger, so channel Soothing Mist on them and top them to 100% with Vivify and Enveloping Mist
Ziekket: [광역 피해] Handle constant Oozing Xylem damage by keeping Renewing Mist rolling, extending with Rising Sun Kick's Rising Mist, and Jadefire Teachings healing
[탱버] Put Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on the tank knocked away by Thornspike to cover the 10 sec bleed

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Detox the Toxic Spores poison; if it stacked on several people after the mushroom soaks, clear them all at once with Revival
[광역 피해] Use Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) for the 10 sec Ravenous Bellow DoT
Sentinel of Winter: [해제] Detox the Glacial Torment magic DoT; if it's on several people, use Revival
[광역 피해] Pop Invoke Chi-Ji for Frozen Tempest. While it's active you're immune to movement impairing effects and Enveloping Mist is instant
[제어] You have no interrupt, so if there aren't enough people to stop Winter's Shroud, use Leg Sweep or Paralysis on the Fractured Shivercore
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Recover the party with Sheilun's Gift and Vivify after the Overwhelming Onslaught knockback
[광역 피해] Line up Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Invoke Chi-Ji with Fury of the War God. You can move while channeling Celestial Conduit

[탱버] Right after taking the three Overwhelming Onslaught hits (315193 Physical each, ignores armor) the tank steps in to soak Forceful Slam (775859 Physical within 6 yd), so put Life Cocoon on the tank before the first hit to carry both with one 12 sec shield

Kystia Manaheart: [해제] Detox the Corroding Spittle magic DoT

[광역 피해] Alternate Invoke Chi-Ji and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) for each 20 sec Destabilized window, and use Rising Sun Kick and Spinning Crane Kick for both damage and healing
[제어] If there aren't enough people to stop the Mirror Images clones' Felstorm, Leg Sweep the grouped clones
Zaen Bladesorrow: [해제] Remove Heartstop Poison from the tank with Detox right away
[광역 피해] Use Invoke Chi-Ji when Killing Spree overlaps with the Fel-Infused Freight dot

[탱버] Right after the pull, the Warehouse Workers dragged in hit the tank along with the boss, so put Life Cocoon on the tank with the second Bloodlust and keep Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on them until the workers die
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Put Life Cocoon on the tank before Legion Strike so the absorb carries them through the 8 sec healing reduction

[탱버] During the 15 sec Demonic Rage the boss gains 75% attack speed and hits the tank much harder, so if Life Cocoon is not ready put a Thunder Focus Tea empowered Enveloping Mist on the tank and support it with a Soothing Mist channel

[광역 피해] Spread Renewing Mist before Infernal Crush and use Sheilun's Gift for the Chaos damage at the end of the Demonic Rage cast. If the group uses the third Bloodlust on the second Demonic Rage, pop Invoke Chi-Ji with it
Lithiel Cinderfury: [광역 피해] Handle constant Searing Fel Flame damage by keeping Renewing Mist up and Way of the Crane healing from Spinning Crane Kick on the adds
[제어] Leg Sweep the Wild Imps gathered by Fingers of Gul'dan to stop Felfire Burst

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Pre-apply Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist before Dark Bloom, and use Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) when it goes off
[회피] Use Roll to move around the orbs, and don't drink Mana Tea in this phase since channeling it reduces your movement speed by 40%
Atroxus: [광역 피해] While Toxic Creeper is alive, hit it with Rising Sun Kick and Blackout Kick to help kill it, and cover Toxic Aura damage with Jadefire Teachings healing
[탱버] Put Enveloping Mist on the tank before Hulking Claw, and use Life Cocoon at high Sickening Bite stacks
[해제] The Mind-Numbing Poison from Poison Splash and Poison Pool is a poison effect. Detox party members with the 30% haste reduction
Charonus: [광역 피해] Use Invoke Chi-Ji for the 20 sec Cosmic Crash dot

[참고] During Gravitic Orbs, the DPS dragging orbs into the Singularities stack Condensed Mass and move far away, so put Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on them and channel Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) while moving to follow
[회피] If you are pulled toward an Unstable Singularity, use Roll to get distance

The Golden Serpent: [광역 피해] Spread Renewing Mist before Serpentine Gust, and spread Invigorating Mists healing with Vivify after the knockback
[제어] Push the Animated Gold packs from Lucre's Call away with Ring of Peace or stun them with Leg Sweep before they reach the boss
Mchimba the Embalmer: [광역 피해] Spend all Renewing Mist charges before Awakening Slam
[제어] If the 2 awakened Half-Finished Mummies are together, delay their Wretched Discharge casts with Leg Sweep
The Council of Tribes: [해제] Detox the poison from Zanazal's Poison Nova; if several people have it, clear them all at once with Revival
[탱버] Use Life Cocoon on the tank during the 10 sec of Shattered Defenses after Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand
Dazar, The First King: [광역 피해] Stack Revival and Invoke Chi-Ji (or Celestial Conduit) for Gilded Destruction. Master of Harmony, release vitality with Thunder Focus Tea right before
[탱버] After 80%, when Blade Combo follows Savage Maul, use Life Cocoon on the tank

Melidrussa Chillworn: [광역 피해] Use Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) for Frost Overload at the 66% and 33% intermissions, and Spinning Crane Kick the Infused Whelp packs

[탱버] The tank kicks Frigid Shard (775859 Physical) right after the Hailburst ice lands. If the tank misses it while moving off the ice, it lands in full, so pre-apply Enveloping Mist on the tank just before Hailburst

[해제] Infused Whelp's Cold Claws is a magic effect and becomes Frozen Solid at 20 stacks, so Detox the party members with the most stacks first. If there are many whelps and someone will reach 20 stacks before Detox (8 sec) is back, clear it with Revival
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] When Searing Blows stacks up Searing Wounds, channel Soothing Mist on the tank and add Enveloping Mist and Vivify; if it gets dangerous, use Life Cocoon
[광역 피해] Use Invoke Chi-Ji for the Blazebound Firestorm's Inferno stacks
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of Interrupting Cloudburst, stop casting Vivify, Enveloping Mist and Sheilun's Gift and use instant spells like Renewing Mist and Rising Sun Kick
[광역 피해] Stack Invoke Chi-Ji and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) at the start of phase 2
[해제] The Stormslam debuff (381515) is a magic effect, so Detox it before the next Stormslam and keep Enveloping Mist on the tank

Adderis & Aspix: [광역 피해] Spread Renewing Mist before Thunder and Lightning, and save Invoke Chi-Ji for the Aspix phase after Adderis dies
[참고] Put Enveloping Mist on the Gust target
Merektha: [해제] Detox the poison from the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit. This dungeon has a lot of poison to dispel, so put Detox on an easy-to-press key
[광역 피해] Use Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) for Serpentstorm, and Spinning Crane Kick the add packs from Hatch
[제어] Lock down the snakes gathered by A Knot of Snakes with Leg Sweep
Galvazzt: [참고] Keep Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on the beam soakers, and use Life Cocoon if a soaker with Galvanized stacks is in danger
[광역 피해] After Induction AoE damage, use Sheilun's Gift with your stored clouds
Avatar of Sethraliss: [참고] For 30 sec after the Essence Defiler dies, channel Soothing Mist on the Avatar and add Thunder Focus Tea-empowered Enveloping Mist and Vivify
[제어] Hold Faithless Tormentor packs chasing the healer with Leg Sweep or Ring of Peace

443589.d:
천신합일의 지속시간 동안 천신합일을 재시전하여, 위대한 천신회 모두를 불러내 200%의 효율로 도움을 받을 수 있도록 합니다.

만료되기 전에 사용하지 않아 천신합일의 효과가 끝나면 내면의 단결이 자동으로 시전됩니다.

450508.d:
준 피해의 10%를, 치유량의 30%를 활력으로 축적합니다. 초과 치유로 축적되는 활력이 감소합니다.

집중의 천둥 차 시전 후 10초 동안 주문 및 능력 사용 시 축적된 활력을 소모해 40%만큼 8초에 걸쳐 생명력을 추가로 회복시킵니다.

450529.d:
조화의 형으로 생명력을 회복시키면 일정 확률로 주위의 아군에게 전이됩니다. 영향을 받는 대상을 직접 치유하면 일정 확률로 효과가 격렬해져 추가로 활력을 끌어내 효과를 최대 20%까지 증가시킵니다.

생기 충전이 활력을 부여하지 않습니다. 조화의 형이 활성화되어 있지 않을 때 생기 충전 시전 시 사용 가능한 활력을 끌어내 100%만큼 8초에 걸쳐 생명력을 추가로 회복시킵니다.

다른 능력으로 축적되는 활력이 50%만큼 증가합니다.

451017.d: 포용의 안개 시전 시 [(주문력 * 300 / 100) * (1 + 유연성)]의 활력을 추가로 저장합니다.

451036.d: 자신에게 시전 시 단일 대상 치유 주문이 10%의 생명력을 추가로 회복시키고 6초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 150%)만큼 치유합니다.

467293.d:
고대의 가르침이 추가로 320%의 피해를 치유량으로 전환합니다.

체력이 8%만큼 증가합니다.

1242910.d: 집중의 천둥 차 사용 시 현재 위치에 옥룡 조각상을 소환합니다. 위안의 안개를 집중시키면 조각상도 대상에게 위안의 안개를 집중하며, 8초 동안 (주문력의 560%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

1262667.m: 특성 · 매 분마다 약 1.5번 효과 발동됨
1262667.d:
생기 충전 및 셰이룬의 선물 시전 시 일정 확률로 옥룡의 마음이 4초 동안 100%의 효율로 시전됩니다.

(500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1262672.d: 옥룡의 마음이 활성화된 동안 가속이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

1266811.d: 생기 충전과 셰이룬의 선물 시전 시 자신에게 부여된 안개 돌풍을 발동시킵니다.

1270958.d:
집중의 천둥 차 시전 시 잠재된 기운 2중첩이 부여됩니다. 다음에 범의 장풍 또는 생기 충전을 시전하면 모든 잠재된 기운 중첩을 소모하여 조화의 쇄도를 발동시킵니다.

조화의 쇄도:
잠재된 기운 중첩 하나당 대상에게 [(주문력의 400%) * 10 / 100]의 자연 피해를, 주위 다른 적에게는 [(주문력의 400%) * 10 / 100]의 자연 피해를 입히고, 최대 5명의 아군을 [(주문력의 500%) * 40 / 100]만큼 치유합니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1277302.d: 해오름차기의 공격력이 시전자의 특화에 따라 증가하며, 집중의 천둥 차의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

1280297.d: 소생의 안개가 생명력이 가장 낮은 아군의 생명력을 500%만큼 추가로 회복시킵니다.

1: [광역 피해] When everything is gathered and Bloodlust goes out, pop Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min with Gift of the Celestials, 12 sec) so Celestial Harmony shields (10 sec) soak Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec). While Chi-Ji is up, chain Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Spinning Crane Kick to heal.
[탱버] Life Cocoon used on Virid Grovekeeper's Earthrupture Strike (533403 Physical) comes back after 1 min 15 sec with Chrysalis, in time for the Grovekeeper in pull 3, so spend it freely.

[제어] You have no interrupt, so when Radiant Spellsower flees at low health with Call The Grove, stun it with Leg Sweep (10 yd radius with Tiger Tail Sweep). If it is already out of range, drop Ring of Peace on the dormant Lasher pack to push the Spellsower out.
2: [광역 피해] Invoke Chi-Ji from pull 1 is not back yet, so use Celestial Conduit (1 min 30 sec, 4 sec channel while moving) for Spouting Floret (Conduit of the Celestials build). Master of Harmony releases Aspect of Harmony vitality with Thunder Focus Tea (2 charges with Endless Draught) and then casts Vivify on targets with Renewing Mist.
[제어] If the kickers cannot cover both Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley (174568 Holy, 4 sec cast), stun both with Leg Sweep once they are stacked on the tank to stop the casts.
3: [탱버] If Life Cocoon is not back for Earthrupture Strike, pre-apply an Enveloping Mist on the tank empowered by Thunder Focus Tea for its instant heal.
[참고] If Spore Spines slows from the 12 Lashers stack up on the tank, use Tiger's Lust (30 sec) on the tank to clear the snare.
5: [광역 피해] Pop the returned Invoke Chi-Ji when Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first to cover Spouting Floret, then line up Life Cocoon for Earthrupture Strike when Virid Grovekeeper arrives 5-6 sec later.
[제어] When Thorny Saptor leaps on a party member with Thornclaw Leap, stun it with Leg Sweep to stop the follow-up cone strikes (145474 Physical).
7: [탱버] The Grievous Gash bleed from the two Luminous Thornmaws (48491 Physical per sec, stacking) only drops at full health. Life Cocoon increases healing over time received by 50% and applies Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist, so use it once the tank has 2 or more stacks.
[탱버] Without Life Cocoon, channel Soothing Mist on the tank and top them to 100% with instant Enveloping Mist and Vivify. Thunder Focus Tea on Enveloping Mist adds an immediate heal.
8: [광역 피해] Use Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min) for Spouting Floret, or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) if Chi-Ji is not back.
[제어] When the two Thorny Saptors leap in with Thornclaw Leap, stun them together with Leg Sweep.
10: [해제] The Toxic Spew poison (58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec) hits the whole party, so answer the first Toxic Spew with Revival (3 min) to heal everyone and clear the poison at once, then Detox (8 sec) the lowest party member one at a time afterwards (Wowhead).
11: [탱버] The Grievous Gash bleed from Luminous Thornmaw only drops at full health, so spend Life Cocoon on that bleed and assign whichever of Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit is ready to Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
[제어] Disorienting Screech (3 sec disorient) from the three Lightfeather Petalwings stops your healing, so stun the Petalwings stacked on the tank together with Leg Sweep to break the casts.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, so ask the group to wait until both Invoke Chi-Ji and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) are ready, then spend one on Spouting Floret and one on a missed Light Bolt Volley (174568 Holy). If Revival (3 min) from pull 10 is back, use it as well.
[탱버] Enemies near a Lightgorged Lasher with its Lightbloom Pollination shield gain 50% attack speed, so keep Enveloping Mist and Renewing Mist rolling on the tank until the shield breaks.
[제어] Stun Radiant Spellsowers fleeing with Call The Grove with Leg Sweep. Lashers wrapped in the Pollination shield are immune to crowd control, so Leg Sweep does nothing to them.

1: [해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (67888 Nature + 48491 every sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) is a Magic effect, so remove it with Detox (8 sec). Clear the most slowed party member first.

[제어] If the seven Ravenous Descendants live long, stack Ravenous Claws attack speed and drain the tank fast, Leg Sweep the pack stacked on the tank (3 sec stun, 10 yd radius with Tiger Tail Sweep) to drop the stacks.
[탱버] If a Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss is missed and the tank takes 135775 Physical with 30% less haste, put Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec with Chrysalis) on the tank to cover the 6 sec.
2: [광역 피해] Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the party + absorbs the next 162029 healing) is the most painful trash ability on this route. Pop Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min with Gift of the Celestials, 12 sec) right before the first Blood Sacrifice so Celestial Harmony shields (5 players, 10 sec) take it, then burn the remaining heal absorb with Sheilun's Gift and Vivify.

[탱버] When Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical) starts, put Life Cocoon on the tank. If you already spent it in pull 1, pre-apply an Enveloping Mist empowered by Thunder Focus Tea for its instant heal.
3: [광역 피해] Invoke Chi-Ji went out in pull 2, so use Celestial Conduit (1 min 30 sec, 4 sec channel while moving) for Blood Sacrifice (Conduit of the Celestials build). Master of Harmony releases Aspect of Harmony vitality with Thunder Focus Tea (2 charges with Endless Draught) to clear the heal absorb.

[탱버] If Life Cocoon went out in pull 2 it will not be back for Dismember, so pre-apply Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on the tank and, after the cast lands, channel Soothing Mist and top them with Vivify.
4: [광역 피해] This is the third Ritual Chieftain. Use Invoke Chi-Ji from pull 2 (1 min) on Blood Sacrifice if it is back, and line up Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec) for Dismember if it is back.
5: [해제] When Paralyzing Shots from two Twinfang Harrowers overlap with Blood Sacrifice, one Detox (8 sec) is not enough, so use Revival (3 min). Revival heals the whole party and removes up to 3 Magic effects, clearing the Paralyzing Shots dots at once.
[탱버] Use Life Cocoon on Ritual Chieftain's Dismember, or pre-apply a Thunder Focus Tea empowered Enveloping Mist on the tank if it is not back.
7: [해제] Remove High Evolutionist's Envenom poison (58189 Nature + 24246 every sec for 8 sec) with Detox right away. Clear it before Rattling Writhe's Rattle (5 sec party Physical, ignores armor) lands on top of it.

[탱버] When Rattling Writhe's Corrosive Fangs (3 sec cast, 242456 Nature + 20% more damage taken for 20 sec) lands, put Life Cocoon (12 sec) on the tank to carry the start of that window with the absorb and 50% increased healing over time.
[제어] If a High Evolutionist starts Evolve (6 sec channel) and nobody kicks it, stun it with Leg Sweep. The same stun also stops nearby Bloodletters' melee swings.
8: [제어] The four Bloodletters leave a blood pool on every melee swing, so stun them together with Leg Sweep once they are stacked on the tank.

[광역 피해] When Rattle (58189 Physical every sec for 5 sec, ignores armor) starts, pop Invoke Chi-Ji so Celestial Harmony shields take it, or channel Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) if Chi-Ji is not ready.
9: [해제] If both High Evolutionists land Envenom on two players, Detox's 8 sec cooldown leaves one behind. If both are poisoned and Rattle is coming, clear the poison at once with Revival.
[탱버] Use Life Cocoon on Corrosive Fangs, or keep Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist rolling on the tank if it is still on cooldown from pull 7.
[제어] When the far-left High Evolutionist is pulled in and channels Evolve, break it with Leg Sweep.
11: [해제] When four High Evolutionists spread Envenom over several players, Detox (8 sec) cannot keep up, so clear the poison at once with Revival (3 min). If Revival went out in pull 9 it is not back, so Detox the lowest party member first.
[제어] Break Evolve channels with Leg Sweep. If the four are spread out, stop one Evolve separately with Paralysis (45 sec).
12: [탱버] Put Life Cocoon on the tank for Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (67888 Nature every sec for 5 sec). Follow the tank while they are pushed back so they stay in healing range.

[광역 피해] Infest (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd) bursts overlap because the party is stacked, so use Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) on the second Infest.
13: [광역 피해] Pop Invoke Chi-Ji for Ula'tek's Chosen's Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec). While Chi-Ji is up you are immune to movement impairing effects and Enveloping Mist is instant, so keep healing while dodging Toxic Beam.
[제어] During Toxic Surge, Leg Sweep the two Blades of the Altar next to the tank so they cannot teleport with Laced Edge.
14: [광역 피해] If Invoke Chi-Ji from pull 13 (1 min) is not back, use Celestial Conduit on Toxic Surge (Conduit of the Celestials build), or Revival with Master of Harmony. Celestial Conduit can be channeled while moving, so you can still dodge Toxic Beam.
[제어] Stun the Blades of the Altar with Leg Sweep during Toxic Surge.
15: [해제] Remove Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots with Detox.
[제어] Four Blades of the Altar are attached to this pull, so stun them together with Leg Sweep once they are stacked on the tank to delay the Laced Edge teleport strikes.
16: [광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice from two Ritual Chieftains overlaps with Ula'tek's Chosen's Toxic Surge, making this the hardest pull on the route. Ask the group to wait until Invoke Chi-Ji, Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) and Revival are all ready, then use Chi-Ji on the first Blood Sacrifice, Conduit on Toxic Surge and Revival on the second Blood Sacrifice.
[탱버] The two Ritual Chieftains' Dismember casts come back to back, so use Life Cocoon on the first and a Thunder Focus Tea empowered Enveloping Mist on the second.
[제어] Stun the two Blades of the Altar with Leg Sweep during Toxic Surge.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull, with Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together. Pop Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min with Gift of the Celestials, 12 sec) with Bloodlust and damage the Captain with Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Spinning Crane Kick while Chi-Ji heals.
[해제] Detox (8 sec) Heartstop Poison (193965 Nature over 8 sec, 5% max health reduction per stack) from the two Street Sneaks off the tank as soon as it stacks.
[탱버] Bribed Guard's Shield Bash increases Physical damage taken by 20% for 20 sec, so put Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec with Chrysalis) on the tank if Heartstop Poison stacks on top of it.
2: [해제] Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (6 sec disorient) is a Magic effect, so Detox the affected player. Freeing a disoriented DPS first gets the kick rotation going again.
[제어] If a Seduction kick is about to be missed, stun both Seductive Sayaads stacked on the tank with Leg Sweep to stop the cast.
3: [탱버] Bribed Guard's Shield Bash increases Physical damage taken by 20% for 20 sec, so keep Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist rolling on the tank. Put Renewing Mist on players hit by Row Hooligan's Cutpurse bleed (155172 over 8 sec).
4: [해제] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks faster than Detox's 8 sec cooldown. If the tank's max health has dropped a lot, clear the poison at once with Revival (3 min), and do not hold Revival if other players are poisoned too.
5: [해제] When a player hit by Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle (Fire dot) calls for a dispel, remove it with Detox.

[광역 피해] Massive Felwyrm deals 38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec through Over-infused, so pop Invoke Chi-Ji while it is alive, and heal from outside Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd) when it dies.
8: [광역 피해] When Shivan Punisher starts Demonic Frenzy below 50% health (29095 Fire every sec until it dies), pop Invoke Chi-Ji and keep Renewing Mist rolling until the DPS kill it.
[제어] If the kickers miss Fel Invoker's Health Funnel or Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, crowd control immunity afterwards), stun them with Leg Sweep.
[탱버] Shadow Bite from the two Trained Felhunters (38793 Shadow per melee swing) stacks up on the tank, so keep Enveloping Mist on the tank.
9: [참고] If the Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life target cannot use a defensive, put Life Cocoon on that player. The absorb and 50% increased healing over time keep them up and cut how much the Warlock heals.

[광역 피해] Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec, split among everyone within 4 yd) is a curse you cannot remove. Stack on the target with the group and put Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on the stacked players before it goes off.
10: [제어] If the kickers miss the first Health Funnel (30 sec channel) from the two Fel Invokers, break it with Leg Sweep.

[광역 피해] If Invoke Chi-Ji from pull 8 is not back for Shivan Punisher's Demonic Frenzy, use Celestial Conduit (1 min 30 sec, 4 sec channel while moving) (Conduit of the Celestials build). Master of Harmony releases Aspect of Harmony vitality with Thunder Focus Tea (2 charges with Endless Draught).
11: [광역 피해] Split Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (43642 Fire to everyone every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec) between party defensives and your cooldowns. Use Invoke Chi-Ji on the first Blade Dance and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Revival on the second.
13: [광역 피해] The group aims to kill Defiled Golem within two Defiled Slams (145474 Fire to everyone), so use Invoke Chi-Ji on the first Slam and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Revival on the second. Celestial Conduit can be channeled while moving, so you can walk backwards out of Fel Beam.
[제어] When the six Unleashed Imps stack on the tank, stun them together with Leg Sweep to stop Felfire Burst. If a Wrathguard Flayer is casting Fel Rage, the same Leg Sweep breaks it.
14: [제어] Gather the six Unleashed Imps and the Fel Invoker on the tank, then stun them together with Leg Sweep to stop Felfire Burst and Health Funnel.
[탱버] Shadow Bite from the two Trained Felhunters stacks up on the tank, so keep Enveloping Mist and Renewing Mist on the tank.
15: [참고] Topicx says to fight the Corrupted Warlock and Shivan Punisher separately. While the Warlock is pulled back and killed first, put Life Cocoon on the Drain Life target and pre-place Renewing Mist on players stacked around the Curse of Doom target.
[광역 피해] For the Shivan Punisher's Demonic Frenzy that follows, use whichever of Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) is ready. If neither is, use Revival.
16: [광역 피해] Topicx assigns two party defensives to Defiled Golem's two Defiled Slams. As Mistweaver, line up Invoke Chi-Ji with the first Slam and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Revival with the second. Ask the group to wait until the cooldowns spent in pull 13 are back.
[탱버] Shadow Bite from the two Trained Felhunters stacks on the tank, so keep Enveloping Mist on the tank, and break a missed Fel Invoker Health Funnel with Leg Sweep.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull. Pop Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min with Gift of the Celestials, 12 sec) with Bloodlust so Celestial Harmony shields (5 players, 10 sec) take Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec). You cannot remove the Insatiable Hunger curse (15% max health reduction, stacking), so ask the group to kill Starvation Effigy before the second stack.

[탱버] You cannot remove the Mother's Wrath enrage (50% more damage dealt, stacking) from the two Territorial Matriarchs. If nobody can soothe it, put Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec with Chrysalis) on the tank at 2 stacks.
[참고] Put Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on players stacking Keen-Eyed Striker's Razor Dive bleed (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking) so they last until it expires.
2: [해제] Thornclaw Gatherer's Rotten Supplies is a Disease effect, so Detox (8 sec) the player it hits.
[제어] If the kickers miss Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) or Earth Bolt, stun it with Leg Sweep. You have no interrupt, so this stun is your only way to stop the cast.

[광역 피해] Invoke Chi-Ji from pull 1 is not back for Feast of Misery, so use Celestial Conduit (1 min 30 sec, 4 sec channel while moving) (Conduit of the Celestials build). Master of Harmony releases Aspect of Harmony vitality with Thunder Focus Tea (2 charges with Endless Draught).
4: [참고] Three Keen-Eyed Strikers stack Razor Dive bleeds on several players, so spend both Renewing Mist charges on the bleeding targets first and cast Vivify for Invigorating Mists healing.
[광역 피해] Use the returned Invoke Chi-Ji on Feast of Misery.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss. Ask the group to wait until Invoke Chi-Ji and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) are ready, then spend one each when missed Earth Bolts (116379 Nature) from the two Earthwhisper Tenders pile up.
[탱버] With two Territorial Matriarchs and no soothe, tank Physical damage is high. Put Life Cocoon on the tank when Mother's Wrath stacks up.
[제어] When the two Earthwhisper Tenders stack on the tank, stun them together with Leg Sweep as Healing Breeze starts.
8: [탱버] Five Frostfangs bite only the tank with Frostbite (67888 Frost) and gain 60% attack speed during Bloodrush. Two Territorial Matriarchs are in this pull too, so put Life Cocoon on the tank when Bloodrush overlaps. Without Cocoon, use a Thunder Focus Tea empowered Enveloping Mist.

[광역 피해] Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward (24246 Nature to everyone every 2 sec while the shield holds) lasts up to 1 min, so roll Renewing Mist on every charge and keep Jadefire Teachings healing going with Rising Sun Kick and Blackout Kick.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull. Pop Invoke Chi-Ji with Bloodlust and keep Chi-Ji healing going with Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Spinning Crane Kick while Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward ticks.
[해제] Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge is a Magic effect, so Detox the affected player right away. If it is not removed, that player damages everyone within 4 yd, so have them move away from the group.
[제어] If the kickers miss Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction) from the two Frigid Maulers, stun them with Leg Sweep.
10: [해제] If both Glacial Revenants put Cryo Surge on two players, Detox's 8 sec cooldown leaves one behind. When they overlap, clear both at once with Revival (3 min).
[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust, so spend the Celestial Conduit you held in pull 9 here (Conduit of the Celestials build).
11: [광역 피해] Avatar of Determination's Glacial Tomb traps the whole party and deals 38793 Frost every 2 sec until broken. Pre-place Renewing Mist charges and Enveloping Mist before the cast, then cover the tomb with Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build).
[해제] Remove Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge with Detox.
13: [광역 피해] The two Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking), so use Invoke Chi-Ji on the first Echo and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Thunder Focus Tea (Master of Harmony build) on the second.
[제어] If the kickers miss Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, 3 targets) from the two Stormbound Mystics, stun them with Leg Sweep.
14: [광역 피해] Damage builds while the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (36368 Fire to everyone every 0.3 sec) are up, so hold with Renewing Mist and Sheilun's Gift until the totems die, and pop Invoke Chi-Ji if the group uses the third Bloodlust here.
[참고] When a Bonded Beasttamer's pet fixates a player with Bestial Wrath, put Enveloping Mist on that player and use Life Cocoon if it gets dangerous.
15: [광역 피해] Primal Echo from four Grizzled Warbringers is the most dangerous thing on this route. The Warbringers do not cast Primal Echo at the same time, so top the party between Echoes and spend Invoke Chi-Ji, Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) and Revival one per Echo. Ask the group to wait until all three are ready.
[제어] Break missed Arc Lightning casts from the two Stormbound Mystics with Leg Sweep.
16: [광역 피해] If the group uses Bloodlust on Loa Speaker Nanea at high keys, pop Invoke Chi-Ji with it to cover Volatile Flames from the Volatile Totems. While you move around Earthquake pools (30 sec), Chi-Ji makes Enveloping Mist instant.
[제어] If the kickers miss Nanea's Lightning Bolt, stun her with Leg Sweep.

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull that takes the first corridor up to the Voidtouched Magi. Pop Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min with Gift of the Celestials, 12 sec) with Bloodlust so Celestial Harmony shields (5 players, 10 sec) take any missed Shadowbolt Volley (193965 Shadow within 60 yd).

[탱버] When Feral Saberon's Savage Leap bleed (38793 Physical every sec for 5 sec) stacks on the tank, put Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec with Chrysalis) on the tank. Cocoon increases healing over time received by 50% and applies Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist.
[참고] When the Null Eruption target (145474 Shadow within 10 yd + 5 sec dot) steps out of the group, pre-place Renewing Mist on them and follow to stay in range.
2: [광역 피해] Raj'kess the Spellstorm's Thundering Storm is long party damage, so if Invoke Chi-Ji from pull 1 is not back use Celestial Conduit (1 min 30 sec, 4 sec channel while moving) (Conduit of the Celestials build). Master of Harmony uses Revival (3 min). Celestial Conduit can be channeled while moving, so you can dodge Raging Typhoon while healing.

[참고] Heal players hit by Forked Lightning (77586 Nature, bounces to 2 nearby players) while staying spread so they do not chain, and help kill the Orb of Disruption orbs with Rising Sun Kick and Blackout Kick.
3: [광역 피해] Pop Invoke Chi-Ji for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature to everyone every 2 sec for 10 sec). If Chi-Ji is not ready, use Revival (3 min). Ask the group to kill Angry Krolusk fast before its Violent Sand (155172 Nature to everyone) overlaps.
[해제] Sycophantic Tarasek's Melt Armor (10% more Fire damage taken for 10 sec) is a Magic effect, so Detox it off the tank. The damage is small, so delay it if another dispel is more urgent.
[탱버] Put Life Cocoon on the tank when Brutok's Head Bash knockback overlaps with Savage Leap bleeds from the five Feral Saberons.
5: [광역 피해] Before the Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak (5 sec cast, 872842 Nature shared within 10 yd), spread Renewing Mist charges and Enveloping Mist on the party, then top up players knocked into the air with Vivify after the soak.
[제어] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area. If the kicker is about to miss it, stun the Screamer with Leg Sweep.
6: [광역 피해] Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams (48491 Physical to everyone every 1.5 sec for 30 sec, +10% per slam) grows until the shield breaks, so pop Invoke Chi-Ji as the stacks rise, and add Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Revival if it overlaps with the Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak.
8: [탱버] Devouring Brutalizer always follows Dreadbellow with Brutalize (678877 Physical every 1.5 sec for 6 sec). When Dreadbellow starts, put Life Cocoon on the tank so the absorb takes the Brutalize that follows.

[광역 피해] Dreadbellow (knockback + 29095 Shadow to everyone every sec for 12 sec) cannot be dispelled, so cover it with Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build). Reapply Renewing Mist on players scattered by the knockback.
[제어] Break a missed Kilivore Screamer Mad Shriek with Leg Sweep, and Detox Sycophantic Tarasek's Melt Armor when you have time.
9: [탱버] For the second Devouring Brutalizer's Brutalize, use Life Cocoon again if it is back from pull 8 (1 min 15 sec). Otherwise put a Thunder Focus Tea empowered Enveloping Mist on the tank during Dreadbellow and channel Soothing Mist.
[광역 피해] Use whichever of Invoke Chi-Ji or Celestial Conduit you did not spend in pull 8 on Dreadbellow.
[제어] Break a missed Kilivore Screamer Mad Shriek with Leg Sweep.
10: [광역 피해] Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow and Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike come back to back in this pull. Use Invoke Chi-Ji on Dreadbellow and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Revival after the Sky Strike soak.

[탱버] Use Life Cocoon on Brutalize, or pre-apply a Thunder Focus Tea empowered Enveloping Mist on the tank if it is not back. Put Renewing Mist on players stacking Savage Leap bleeds from the two Feral Saberons.

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull. When a Shadow-Borne Champion starts casting Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow to the whole party), pop Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min with Gift of the Celestials, 12 sec) so Celestial Harmony shields (5 players, 10 sec) take it. Channel Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) on the second cast; on the Master of Harmony build, release Aspect of Harmony vitality with Thunder Focus Tea.
[탱버] When the two Animated Guardians dragged into the next room overlap Heavy Slams, put Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec with Chrysalis) on the tank.

[제어] Stun the Minion of Zul on the way with Leg Sweep (10 yd radius with Tiger Tail Sweep) to hold it in place. Mistweaver cannot strip the Bound by Shadow shield from an enemy, so leave the purge to another party member.
2: [광역 피해] Shadow Whirlwind comes again. If Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min) from pull 1 is back, use it on the first cast; if not, take it with the Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Thunder Focus Tea (Master of Harmony build) you saved in pull 1.

[해제] Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (116379 Shadow + 38793 every 1 sec for 12 sec) is a curse, so Detox and Revival cannot remove it. If the 3.5 sec cast goes up with no kick available, stop it with Leg Sweep, and keep Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on anyone affected to carry them through the 12 sec.
4: [탱버] When Blood Drain (164870 Physical to bleeding targets) comes while King A'akul's Mortal Bleed (48491 Physical every 1 sec for 18 sec, healing received reduced by 20%) is on the tank, put Life Cocoon on the tank. Cocoon's 50% increased healing over time boosts the Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist applied by Mists of Life and offsets the healing reduction.

[광역 피해] The four Bloodsworn Assassins' Sudden Rupture bleeds (24246 Physical every 1 sec for 18 sec) cannot be removed by Detox or Revival, and every bleeding player gets hit by Blood Drain. When the A'akul group wakes up, pop Invoke Chi-Ji so Celestial Harmony shields absorb Blood Drain, and put Renewing Mist on every bleeding player.
[제어] Mistweaver cannot remove Guard Captain Atu's Captain's Bulwark (2.5 sec cast, nearby mobs take 30% less damage), so when the cast goes up, stun Atu with Leg Sweep from close range to delay it.
5: [광역 피해] Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole party + a zone) has to be taken while backpedaling on the bridge. Use Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build), which you can channel while moving, or Invoke Chi-Ji, which grants movement impairment immunity and instant Enveloping Mist. On high keys where Bloodlust is used here, add Revival (3 min) as well.

[해제] Remove Embalming Fluid's Putrid Seekers (poison, 20% movement speed reduction + 38793 Nature every 1 sec for 12 sec) with Detox (8 sec). If several players have it when Purifying Flame lands, clear the poison all at once with Revival.
6: [해제] If a Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast) is missed, the whole party gets a disease (116379 Nature every 2 sec for 12 sec). Detox only clears one player every 8 sec, so clear the disease all at once with Revival (3 min).
[제어] If the group is one kick short, stun both Mummies with Leg Sweep when they are stacked on the tank to stop Wretched Discharge.
7: [해제] If you used Revival in pull 6, it is not back, so when Wretched Discharge is missed, Detox the lowest-health players first. Improved Detox clears poison and disease together, so pick players who have both Putrid Seekers and the disease first.
[광역 피해] If the Entomb target is freed late, Wail of Mourning (77586 Shadow to the whole party every 2 sec, growing over time) keeps going, so pop Invoke Chi-Ji if freeing them takes a while.
9: [제어] The two Phantom Hex Priests' Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec transform) is a curse, so Detox cannot remove it. When the tank gathers the Hex Priests, stop both casts at once with Leg Sweep (10 yd radius).

[탱버] The two Royal Berserkers' Bloodthirsty Axe bleed (29095 Physical every 1 sec for 12 sec, 2 targets) cannot be removed by Detox. If the bleed stacks on the tank, put Life Cocoon on the tank, and put Enveloping Mist on the other target.
10: [탱버] The 30% increased Physical damage taken from Ghostly Brute's Soul Crush lasts 15 sec, but Life Cocoon lasts 12 sec. Cover the last 3 sec after Cocoon ends with an Enveloping Mist empowered by Thunder Focus Tea. If you used Cocoon in pull 9, check that 1 min 15 sec has passed before pulling.

[회피] Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical to nearby players + knock-up) also hits a Mistweaver using Spinning Crane Kick in melee, so Roll out when the cast goes up, and put Renewing Mist on the tank before leaving.
12: [위치] If you soak the far Pool of Darkness, put Renewing Mist and Enveloping Mist on the tank before heading to the pool, and Vivify the tank within 40 yd while standing in it.

[광역 피해] When the Dark Revelation target (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec) moves away from the party, they take the hit alone, so put Enveloping Mist on them and Life Cocoon if their health is low.

1: [탱버] When you gather everything up to the entrance, the four Deepstone Earthshapers' Tectonic Strike (25% increased damage taken, 8 sec, stacking) piles up on the tank right after the pull. If Primal Juggernaut's Crushing Smash (2.5 sec cast, 533403 Physical + 145474 Nature) starts while stacks are high, put Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec with Chrysalis) on the tank.

[광역 피해] Pop Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min with Gift of the Celestials, 12 sec) for the Juggernaut's Excavating Blast (3.5 sec cast, 106681 Nature to the whole party + 33944 every 1 sec for 8 sec) so Celestial Harmony shields (5 players, 10 sec) take it. Put Renewing Mist on the targets of the four Earthbound Guardians' Earthbound's Imprint dot.

[제어] If Tectonic Strike stacks are high, stun the Earthshaper pack next to the tank with Leg Sweep (10 yd radius with Tiger Tail Sweep) to buy time for the stacks to drop. Primal Juggernaut is immune to stuns.
2: [해제] If the eggs in the water are touched and Infused Whelps appear, Detox (8 sec) Cold Claws (magic, Frozen Solid 5 sec stun at 20 stacks) from the players with the most stacks first.

[탱버] If Life Cocoon from pull 1 is not back, put a Thunder Focus Tea-empowered Enveloping Mist on the tank when Crushing Smash starts, and use Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) for Excavating Blast.
3: [탱버] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage (1 sec cast, 242456 Physical every 0.5 sec for 3 sec) needs a tank defensive on every cast, and the Earthshapers' Tectonic Strike stacks make it hit harder. Put Life Cocoon on the tank for the first Steel Barrage, then alternate with a Thunder Focus Tea-empowered Enveloping Mist.

[광역 피해] Each Steel Barrage strike deals 24246 Fire to the whole party, six times, so spread Renewing Mist before the cast and pop Invoke Chi-Ji on a Steel Barrage that doesn't line up with a tank defensive.
5: [제어] The two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel, 96982 Fire + 242456 Physical every 1 sec) cannot be interrupted, so stop both with Leg Sweep (10 yd radius) when they are stacked on the tank. Stop a separated one with Paralysis.

[광역 피해] Pop Invoke Chi-Ji for the Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (Fire damage to the party + 5 sec dot), and put Enveloping Mist on Living Bomb targets (52371 Fire every 1 sec for 6 sec, then a 6 yd explosion) before it explodes.
6: [광역 피해] Once Flamegullet drops below 50%, Molten Blood (48491 Fire to the party every 3 sec, +15% per cast) keeps growing. Pop Invoke Chi-Ji at 50% (with Bloodlust on +17 and above), follow with Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Thunder Focus Tea (Master of Harmony build), and finish with Revival (3 min).

[탱버] Put Life Cocoon on the tank for Flamegullet's Fire Maw (2.5 sec cast, 581895 Physical + 96982 Fire, then 77586 Fire every 1 sec for 6 sec). Cocoon's 50% increased healing over time covers the Fire Maw dot window.
[제어] Stop the Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage channel with Leg Sweep.
7: [광역 피해] If you stacked cooldowns on Molten Blood in pull 6, use Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min), which comes back first, for the Destroyer's Inferno; if it's not back, take it with Sheilun's Gift and Renewing Mist.
[제어] Stop both Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage together with Leg Sweep, and a separated one with Paralysis.
8: [제어] Stop both Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage together with Leg Sweep. Use Leg Sweep and Ring of Peace inside the pack so you don't pull the Thunderhead patrolling nearby.
10: [광역 피해] The six Storm Warriors' Thunderous Stomp (53340 Nature within 60 yd) overlaps, so pop Invoke Chi-Ji right on the pull and Spinning Crane Kick the stacked pack to turn damage into healing through Way of the Crane.
[참고] Put Life Cocoon on the target of Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every 1 sec); if Cocoon is down, give them a Thunder Focus Tea-empowered Enveloping Mist.
[제어] Stop the Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Leg Sweep.
11: [참고] This section is chain-pulled without stopping, so check whether Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec) from pull 10 is back before putting it on the Lightning Torrent target; if not, channel Soothing Mist on them and instant-cast Enveloping Mist and Vivify.
12: [광역 피해] While High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield is up, the whole party takes 29095 Nature every 1 sec, so chain Invoke Chi-Ji and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build); on the Master of Harmony build, release Aspect of Harmony vitality with Thunder Focus Tea.

[참고] If the shield expires unbroken, the party within 60 yd is stunned for 4 sec and your healing stops too, so spread Renewing Mist and put Enveloping Mist on low-health players just before it ends. Put Life Cocoon on the Lightning Torrent target.

1: [해제] Detox (8 sec) Shrouded Fang's Poisoned Cheap Shot (poison, 5 sec stun + 96982 Nature every 1 sec) as soon as it lands. If the tank fails to engage first and someone else takes it, clear that player first.

[광역 피해] If Sandfury Stonefist's Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yd + knockback) overlaps with the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt, people die. When the first Ground Pound cast goes up, pop Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min with Gift of the Celestials, 12 sec) so Celestial Harmony shields (5 players, 10 sec) take it.

[제어] Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel, 43642 Physical every 0.8 sec) has to be stopped with a stun, so use Leg Sweep (10 yd radius with Tiger Tail Sweep) if it is next to the tank, or Paralysis if it is apart.
2: [해제] If the two Shrouded Fangs land Poisoned Cheap Shot on two players, Detox (8 sec) only clears one, so clear the other's poison with Revival (3 min) or put Life Cocoon (1 min 15 sec with Chrysalis) on them to survive the 5 sec stun.
[광역 피해] Ground Pound comes again. If Invoke Chi-Ji from pull 1 is not back, take it with Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Thunder Focus Tea (Master of Harmony build).
4: [제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Paralysis. Save Leg Sweep for when the Sand-Sworn Rider's Swarming Krolusks run at distant DPS.
5: [해제] A player with Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin (poison, 72737 Nature + 38793 every 1 sec for 10 sec) dies if the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt (116379 Nature) also hits them, so Detox the Cytotoxin target the casters are aiming at first. Detox cannot remove the Krolusks' Serrated Charge bleed (6 sec), so put Enveloping Mist on that target.
[탱버] If Krolusk Matriarch's Head Butt (3 sec cast, 727368 Physical) overlaps with a Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleed, put Life Cocoon on the tank.

[광역 피해] The moment the Sand-Sworn Rider on the bridge is pulled in late, Swarming Krolusks adds join too, so pop Invoke Chi-Ji then, or channel Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) if Chi-Ji is down.
6: [해제] Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast, 5 sec disorient) is a curse, so Detox cannot remove it; leave that dispel to a party member who can remove curses. Mistweaver Detoxes the Cytotoxin poison.
[제어] If the assigned kicker misses Addle Mind, stop the Subjugator with Paralysis before the 5 sec cast finishes.
7: [해제] If the three Poisonous Vipers put Cytotoxin on several players, Detox (8 sec) cannot keep up, so clear the poison all at once with Revival. If the Revival (3 min) you used in pull 2 is not back, Detox the Cytotoxin first on players targeted by the Brood Tender's Venom Bolt.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Paralysis, and use Leg Sweep if the kick on Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind is missed.
9: [해제] Imbued Stormcaller's Imbued Conduction (magic, 42672 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec, Conduct Lightning when it expires) is a healer dispel, so remove it with Detox (8 sec). Agitated Nimbus's Accumulate Charge is a magic effect on the enemy, so Mistweaver cannot remove it.

[광역 피해] The two Agitated Nimbuses' Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to the whole party) goes off staggered, so use Invoke Chi-Ji on the first one and Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Thunder Focus Tea (Master of Harmony build) on the second.
10: [광역 피해] This is a dangerous pull where Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge overlaps with the four Static Anomalies' Spark Step (77586 Nature within 5 yd). Check that Invoke Chi-Ji (1 min) from pull 9 is back before pulling, and if both cooldowns are down, use Revival (3 min) on Release Charge.
[해제] Detox the two Imbued Stormcallers' Imbued Conduction. If both land together, Revival removes up to 3 magic effects, so clear them with the Revival you use on Release Charge.
12: [제어] Lock down the Temple Disruptor on the far side of the orb with Paralysis (1 min incapacitate). Damage breaks it, so use it on a Disruptor outside the AoE.
[광역 피해] For Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature within 60 yd + 33459 every 1 sec for 10 sec), spread Renewing Mist before the cast and pop Invoke Chi-Ji.
13: [광역 피해] For the second Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp, use Celestial Conduit (Conduit of the Celestials build) or Thunder Focus Tea (Master of Harmony build) instead of the Invoke Chi-Ji you used in pull 12.
[제어] Lock down the far Temple Disruptor with Paralysis again. If Paralysis is not back, break its Essence Disruption channel with Leg Sweep.
14: [위치] The four Faithless Tormentors fixate on the Mistweaver and apply Shadowlash (5% reduced healing done, stacking) with each melee hit. Drop Ring of Peace at your feet before they reach you to eject them, and if they get on you, stun them with Leg Sweep (10 yd radius) and make distance with Roll or Tiger's Lust on yourself.

[참고] If the kick on Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (242456 Fire + 77586 every 1 sec for 8 sec) is missed, put Enveloping Mist on the target, and keep healing with Renewing Mist while you move away from the Tormentors.
